title: Semi-Riemann Geometry and General Relativity
description: Free online book (251 PDF pages, dated 24 September 2003) from an undergraduate course introducing Riemannian geometry and general relativity: principal curvatures and Gauss's theorema egregium; rules of calculus (forms, Lie derivative, frames, structure equations, parallel transport along ribbons); Levi-Civita connections (linear connections, Christoffel symbols, parallel transport, geodesics, torsion, curvature, Levi-Civita's theorem, sectional and Ricci curvature, bi-invariant metrics, frame fields and curvature forms, the Schwarzschild metric); the bundle of frames; connections on principal bundles; Gauss's lemma (exponential map, normal coordinates, minimisation of arc length); special relativity; the Einstein–Hilbert functional; Riemannian submersions; Petrov types; the star operator.
rightsNotes: The author's books page states 'These books are licensed under a Creative Commons License' and links creativecommons.org/licenses/by-nc-sa/2.0/ (CC BY-NC-SA 2.0): attribution and share-alike required, commercial use excluded. Corniversity is private and non-commercial; importing the PDF for study and citation is within the licence.

The book treats semi-Riemannian (indefinite) metrics alongside Riemannian ones and is used in MAT-262 as the open-licensed alternative reading and for the Lorentzian contrast; the Corniversity lessons keep the Riemannian (positive-definite) case separate and say so.
The style (Cartan calculus, frames, physics applications) differs from the primary notes; citations name the section so the learner can choose.
